coreThesis: AI should help children become more capable and independent, not more dependent.

hero.eyebrow: AI WILL BE PART OF THEIR WORLD.
hero.headlineLine2: Help them learn how to use it well.
hero.body: A learning tool that explains, questions, and practices with kids — then gradually steps out of the way.

marketGap.headline: AI is already here. Guidance isn't.
marketGap.primaryStatLabel: of U.S. children ages 9–17 surveyed in 2026 reported using AI
marketGap.supportingFact: More than 4 in 10 surveyed children said no parent or guardian had ever talked with them about AI safety.

principles.title: Think
principles.body: Get a hint, not the answer.

independenceQuote: Sometimes the best thing our AI can say is: “Try this one without me.”
